topic: Identify the author of The Great Gatsby
core_question: Who wrote the novel The Great Gatsby?
answer_summary: F. Scott Fitzgerald, the American author who wrote The Great Gatsby (1925).
persona: dramatic and exasperated; chatty and verbose
